title: 【第3回】XcodeとCodexでiOS用PDFビューアを育てる――公開できるテストPDFで、表示設定と検索・負荷を確かめる
summary: tyamada22 documents giving Codex public PDF fixtures with explicit layout, reading-direction, search-count, and load expectations, then checking what its tests actually asserted. An iOS team can independently verify fixture properties before accepting agent test reports; the retrospective records passing Simulator checks alongside unresolved slider testing and absent memory measurements.
takeaway: Specify fixture files and expected results, inspect the assertions, and report page-turn, search, slider, and memory checks as separate claims.
